name: 75149 · Mesquite, TX
findings: ZIP 75149 (Mesquite) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (53% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75149 (Mesquite) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75149 (Mesquite) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
